description.value:
Your body has become remarkably supple and controlled. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in the Acrobatics skill, or expertise in it if you already have proficiency. As a bonus action, you may attempt a DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check; success means difficult terrain does not slow your movement for the rest of that turn.
